ingredients.name: salt and black pepper
ingredients.notes: each, plus more salt to taste

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: juice of 1/2 lemon, plus more to taste

steps.text: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a large pot over high heat until shimmering. Add onion and garlic and saute until golden, about 4 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper, and chili powder; saute for 2 minutes.
Add broth, 2 cups water, lentils and carrot. Bring to a simmer, partly cover, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until lentils are soft, about 30 minutes. Adjust salt.
Puree half the soup and return it to the pot, leaving the soup somewhat chunky.
Reheat if needed, then stir in lemon juice and cilantro. Serve drizzled with olive oil and dusted with chili powder if desired.
